exposure: NexfinTM beat-to-beat noninvasive blood pressure monitoring
conventional intermittent oscillometric blood pressure measurement
outcome: time to detect the first relevant hypotensive episode
cohort: 174 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia
finding: The agreement between NexfinTM and an intermittent method for measuring systolic blood pressure was not within an acceptable range during cesarean delivery, although NexfinTM may detect hypotension earlier.
